description: `#integrations`, a `paginatedPanels` block: a {color.panel} card with a vertical logo marquee and a dot-paginated copy rail.

provenance.note: Provenance of this asset in the page being specified. `generated` is FORBIDDEN for any assetRole whose generationPolicy is must-not-fabricate-real-brand or must-not-fabricate-compliance-claim, and for must-reuse-exact roles. Enforced by compatibility/graph.json#ASSET_PROVENANCE_POLICY and schema/semantic_validate.py.

aspectRatio.note: CSS aspect-ratio for the wrapper box (e.g. "799/617"). Used by Rive assets, which have no intrinsic pixel size, INSTEAD of intrinsicWidth/Height.

motion.notes: Vertical Swiper. 15 slides = the 5 logos x 3 copies for looping; each slide is 110px tall. delay 2000 + speed 1000 = a 3000ms period. Paused by IntersectionObserver while offscreen. DISTINCT from industry.logo-showcase’s marquee (248px step) — do not conflate them.

responsive.lg1024: panel flex-row, dot-nav visible, panel min-h-[35rem]

knownUpstreamDefects: The `#integrations` id lives HERE, on the homepage — while the footer link that targets it points at `/platform#integrations`, which does not exist. Reproduced on purpose.
